description: Casa High Five is a modern Rincon home with sweeping ocean views, an open floor plan, and a stunning saltwater infinity pool overlooking the jungle and coastline. This 3BR/2.5BA home features an outdoor shower and is minutes from top beaches, surf breaks, restaurants, and shops. Fully stocked with essentials—just bring your bathing suit and enjoy your Rincon getaway.The spaceEnjoy spacious rooms with A/C in all bedrooms, ceiling fans throughout, and a fully stocked kitchen equipped with everything you need to prepare meals with friends and family. Relax on the upper balcony with ocean and jungle views beside the rooftop succulent garden. A projector with streaming access is available for cozy movie nights.This home sleeps a maximum of 6 guests.Guest accessGuests are welcome to use the entire house, yard and pool.Other things to noteImagine gathering with family and friends at Casa High Five, a newly built luxury retreat tucked inside the private Dos Ceibas neighborhood in the highly desirable Puntas area of Rincón. This modern Caribbean villa blends indoor–outdoor living, ocean views, and a serene tropical setting—perfect for guests seeking relaxation, comfort, and an elevated island experience.Designed by the award-winning Brooklyn architecture firm Big Prototype, Casa High Five was created for vacationers who love style, privacy, and convenience. Although you’ll feel worlds away in this peaceful jungle setting, you’re just minutes from Rincón’s best surf beaches, restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, and nightlife.Modern Design, Caribbean Views, and Cooling Trade WindsThe ground floor features a spacious open-concept layout with an ocean-view kitchen, oversized island, dining area, and living room with expansive windows that capture the Caribbean Sea and northwestern coastline. The home sits along a ridgeline that welcomes year-round trade winds, naturally cooling the house with fresh ocean breezes.3 Bedrooms • 2.5 Bathrooms • Sleeps Up to 7 GuestsCasa High Five includes three air-conditioned bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and thoughtful touches throughout. Perfect for families, couples, or groups, the home offers:A fully stocked chef’s kitchenWeber BBQ grill with gas providedPack ’n play + high chairLuxury linens and bath/beach towelsSnorkel gear, beach chairs & coolersToiletries and essentials for a hassle-free stay🏝 Saltwater Infinity Pool + Lush Tropical GardensThe saltwater infinity pool overlooks both the ocean and surrounding jungle, creating a quintessential Caribbean backdrop. The property is surrounded by fruit trees—mango, avocado, citrus—and vibrant tropical plants, making the outdoor space feel like a private oasis.Minutes From Beaches, Surf Breaks & Top RestaurantsCasa High Five is centrally located to all major Rincon attractions:3 minutes by car to Sandy Beach, Domes, Maria’s, and Steps BeachWalking distance or a short drive to Pool Bar Sushi, La Familia Pizza, Tamboo, Kahuna Burger, and many more local favorites4 minutes to the downtown plaza with shops, art markets, and restaurants5 minutes to both major grocery storesEasy Travel From Multiple AirportsThe closest airport is Aguadilla (BQN)—just 25 minutes away—with direct daily flights from:JFKNewarkFort LauderdaleOrlandoSan Juan (SJU) offers numerous daily flights and is only 2–2.5 hours from the home.No passport required for U.S. citizens traveling to Puerto Rico.Local Culture, Activities & AdventureRincón offers incredible activities including surfing, snorkeling, scuba diving, whale watching (seasonal), paddle boarding, horseback riding, sailing, and waterfall hikes. Weekly art festivals, farmers markets, and live music bring the town to life.Rincón is known for being safe, family-friendly, relaxed, and welcoming, making it the ideal destination for all travelers.
